pieces.text: is an important Christian holiday. On Christmas, many people celebrate the birth of Jesus Christ. He is also called Jesus of Nazareth. He lived 2000 years ago in the Middle East. Christians believe that Jesus is the Son of God.

The story of Jesus's birth starts with a woman named Mary. An angel visited Mary and told her that she was going to have a baby. The angel told Mary to name her son Jesus. Later, Mary and her husband, Joseph, traveled to a city called Bethlehem. When they got there, there was nowhere for them to stay. They had to sleep in a barn where the animals were kept. While Mary and Joseph were in Bethlehem, Jesus was born. They made a bed for him in a
, which is a tub that animals eat from.

paragraphs.text: Angels visited people nearby to tell them about the special new baby. A bright star appeared in the sky. Three kings, sometimes called wise men, followed the star to find baby Jesus. When the three kings found him, they celebrated Jesus's birth by giving special, rare gifts. They gave him gold, a shiny yellow metal that is often used for jewelry. They also gave him frankincense and myrrh, which are used as medicine or perfume.

Later, Mary and her husband, Joseph, traveled to a city called Bethlehem. When they got there, there was nowhere for them to stay. They had to sleep in a barn where the animals were kept. While Mary and Joseph were in Bethlehem, Jesus was born. They made a bed for him in a
, which is a tub that animals eat from.

They also gave him frankincense and myrrh, which are used as medicine or perfume.

pieces.text: is a Mexican holiday. Día de los Muertos means "Day of the Dead" in Spanish. This holiday is a happy time to remember people who have died. People believe that the spirits of the dead come back to visit the living on Día de los Muertos. The spirits of children come to visit on the first day, and the spirits of adults come to visit on the second.
To prepare for the visit, people carefully decorate graves. A

is a place where a dead person is buried. During Día de los Muertos, people clean the graves. They use candles and flowers to add light and color to the graves. They bring food to the graves to have a party. Some people stay all night to visit with the spirits of the dead.

paragraphs.text: People celebrate Día de los Muertos on November 1st and 2nd. That is right after Halloween, but the two holidays are very different. On Halloween, people dress up like scary ghosts and monsters. But on Día de los Muertos, the dead are not scary. People believe the spirits come back to celebrate with the people they love.

The spirits of children come to visit on the first day, and the spirits of adults come to visit on the second.
To prepare for the visit, people carefully decorate graves. A

is a place where a dead person is buried. During Día de los Muertos, people clean the graves. They use candles and flowers to add light and color to the graves. They bring food to the graves to have a party. Some people stay all night to visit with the spirits of the dead.

paragraphs.text: People celebrate Día de los Muertos on November 1st and 2nd. That is right after Halloween, but the two holidays are very different. On Halloween, people dress up like scary ghosts and monsters. But on Día de los Muertos, the dead are not scary. People believe the spirits come back to celebrate with the people they love.

pieces.text: is a holiday in the Christian religion. On Easter, Christians remember a story about Jesus of Nazareth. Christians believe Jesus is the son of God. Jesus lived about 2,000 years ago. He lived in a part of the Middle East that was ruled by the Roman Empire. Many people in that area listened to his teachings. The Romans thought that the ideas Jesus was teaching would make people stop obeying Roman leaders. So they decided to kill Jesus.

paragraphs.text: In the story of Easter, Jesus was buried in a cave. Three days after Jesus died, some of his followers went to the cave. But his body was not there. The followers heard that Jesus had come back to life. Jesus appeared and spoke to some of his followers. Later, Jesus went to live with God in heaven.
Easter is one of the most important holidays in Christianity. Christians believe that, because Jesus died and came back to life, other people will also be able to go to heaven when they die.

pieces.text: is a holiday in the Christian religion. On Easter, Christians remember a story about Jesus of Nazareth. Christians believe Jesus is the son of God. Jesus lived about 2,000 years ago. He lived in a part of the Middle East that was ruled by the Roman Empire. Many people in that area listened to his teachings. The Romans thought that the ideas Jesus was teaching would make people stop obeying Roman leaders. So they decided to kill Jesus.

paragraphs.text: In the story of Easter, Jesus was buried in a cave. Three days after Jesus died, some of his followers went to the cave. But his body was not there. The followers heard that Jesus had come back to life. Jesus appeared and spoke to some of his followers. Later, Jesus went to live with God in heaven.
Easter is one of the most important holidays in Christianity. Christians believe that, because Jesus died and came back to life, other people will also be able to go to heaven when they die.

choices.text: He came back to life and spoke to his followers.

pieces.text: is a Jewish holiday. During Hanukkah, Jewish people remember a story from long ago. Around 2,000 years ago, many Jewish people lived in a place called Judea. The ruler of Judea was a king named Antiochus. He was not Jewish, and he wanted Jewish people to be more like Greek people. So, Antiochus tried to force Jewish people to pray to Greek gods.
Antiochus took over the Jewish Temple. The

was a special place where Jewish people gathered to worship and pray. Antiochus did many things in the Temple that Jewish people did not like. For example, he put a statue of the Greek god Zeus inside the Temple. He also brought pigs into the Temple. Many Jewish people felt these things made the Temple unclean. A group of Jewish people called the
decided to fight back against Antiochus. The Maccabees won and took back the Temple from him.

The Maccabees wanted to light a special candle in the Temple. The candle was never supposed to go out. But it needed oil to burn, and there was only enough for one night. Somehow, the oil lasted for eight days! That gave the Maccabees time to get more oil. People said it was a miracle. A
is an amazing thing that cannot be easily explained. Many people think that God makes miracles happen.

pieces.text: is a Jewish holiday. During Hanukkah, Jewish people remember a story from long ago. Around 2,000 years ago, many Jewish people lived in a place called Judea. The ruler of Judea was a king named Antiochus. He was not Jewish, and he wanted Jewish people to be more like Greek people. So, Antiochus tried to force Jewish people to pray to Greek gods.
Antiochus took over the Jewish Temple. The

was a special place where Jewish people gathered to worship and pray. Antiochus did many things in the Temple that Jewish people did not like. For example, he put a statue of the Greek god Zeus inside the Temple. He also brought pigs into the Temple. Many Jewish people felt these things made the Temple unclean. A group of Jewish people called the
decided to fight back against Antiochus. The Maccabees won and took back the Temple from him.

The Maccabees wanted to light a special candle in the Temple. The candle was never supposed to go out. But it needed oil to burn, and there was only enough for one night. Somehow, the oil lasted for eight days! That gave the Maccabees time to get more oil. People said it was a miracle. A
is an amazing thing that cannot be easily explained. Many people think that God makes miracles happen.

paragraphs.text: Many stories explain how Holi began. One story is about a young prince. He had a mean aunt named Holika. In the story, Holika tricked the prince and he stepped into a fire. The prince prayed to a Hindu god for help. The god saved the prince from the fire, and Holika was burned instead. Today, people burn fires during Holi to remember that the good prince won and the evil aunt lost.

pieces.text: Another Holi story is about the Hindu god Krishna. Krishna had blue skin. He loved a goddess named Radha and wanted her to have colorful skin too. means making your own decisions. On July 4th, 1776, a group of American leaders agreed to the Declaration of Independence. The

pieces.text: Every summer, Americans celebrate
. This holiday is also called the Fourth of July or July 4th. Independence Day celebrates the United States of America becoming a country.

paragraphs.text: Long ago, a country called Great Britain was in charge of America. Americans had to follow Great Britain's laws. They also had to pay money to the king of Great Britain, who was thousands of miles away.

pieces.text: Many Americans did not like being ruled by Great Britain. They wanted independence.
means making your own decisions. On July 4th, 1776, a group of American leaders agreed to the Declaration of Independence. The
announced that America would no longer belong to Great Britain. It was now its own country, the United States of America.

paragraphs.text: Great Britain's leaders did not want America to become independent. So, the two countries went to war. The United States won the war. The United States was now free to make its own decisions and laws.

content.text: During Kwanzaa, younger family members spend time with and learn from older family members.

pieces.text: is a holiday that celebrates African American families. It began in the United States in 1966. A man named Dr. Maulana Karenga started it to help African American people connect with their ancestors.
are family members who lived long ago. During Kwanzaa, many African American people celebrate their families and their history.
In the past, many African people were brought to the Americas as

people. Enslaved means being owned by someone else and forced to work for them. Families were often split up. It was hard for enslaved people to spend time together. They couldn't celebrate holidays the way they did in Africa. Since families often lived apart, it was harder for older people to share family stories. Many
, meaning special things people have done for many years, were lost.
Kwanzaa connects African American people with their ancestors. Some Kwanzaa traditions come from African harvest holidays. For example, the name

means "first fruits" in an African language called Swahili. This name comes from African holidays that celebrate the first fruits and vegetables harvested each year. These harvest holidays honor the hard work people put into growing food together. During Kwanzaa, people think about how to work together to grow their communities, just like how people work together to grow food.

pieces.text: is a holiday that celebrates the beginning of a new year. People in Asia began celebrating it long ago. It is an important holiday in countries like China, Vietnam, and Korea.

means moon. Lunar New Year gets its name because it is based on a calendar that uses the moon. Most people use a calendar that uses only the sun to keep track of time. But the Chinese calendar uses both the sun and the moon. Since Lunar New Year follows a different calendar, its date changes a little every year. In some years, Lunar New Year is in January. In other years, it is in February.

paragraphs.text: In the Chinese calendar, each new year is given the name of an animal. The Chinese calendar has 12 animals, so the names start over every 12 years. Chinese calendars often show the 12 animals in a circle.

For the holiday, people hang signs on their doors and windows that say "Happy New Year!" Often, these signs have pictures of the year's animal on them. Many people keep these signs up all year, until the next Lunar New Year comes!

means moon. Lunar New Year gets its name because it is based on a calendar that uses the moon. Most people use a calendar that uses only the sun to keep track of time. But the Chinese calendar uses both the sun and the moon. Since Lunar New Year follows a different calendar, its date changes a little every year. In some years, Lunar New Year is in January. In other years, it is in February.

paragraphs.text: In the Chinese calendar, each new year is given the name of an animal. The Chinese calendar has 12 animals, so the names start over every 12 years. Chinese calendars often show the 12 animals in a circle.

For the holiday, people hang signs on their doors and windows that say "Happy New Year!" Often, these signs have pictures of the year's animal on them. Many people keep these signs up all year, until the next Lunar New Year comes!

But the Chinese calendar uses both the sun and the moon. Since Lunar New Year follows a different calendar, its date changes a little every year. In some years, Lunar New Year is in January. In other years, it is in February.

paragraphs.text: In the Chinese calendar, each new year is given the name of an animal. The Chinese calendar has 12 animals, so the names start over every 12 years. Chinese calendars often show the 12 animals in a circle.

For the holiday, people hang signs on their doors and windows that say "Happy New Year!" Often, these signs have pictures of the year's animal on them. Many people keep these signs up all year, until the next Lunar New Year comes!

means moon. Lunar New Year gets its name because it is based on a calendar that uses the moon. Most people use a calendar that uses only the sun to keep track of time. But the Chinese calendar uses both the sun and the moon. Since Lunar New Year follows a different calendar, its date changes a little every year. In some years, Lunar New Year is in January. In other years, it is in February.

paragraphs.text: In the Chinese calendar, each new year is given the name of an animal. The Chinese calendar has 12 animals, so the names start over every 12 years. Chinese calendars often show the 12 animals in a circle.

For the holiday, people hang signs on their doors and windows that say "Happy New Year!" Often, these signs have pictures of the year's animal on them. Many people keep these signs up all year, until the next Lunar New Year comes!

Dr. King was born in Georgia in 1929. At that time, many places in the United States were segregated.

means that Black people were kept apart from white people. Black people could not go to the same schools, parks, restaurants, or libraries as white people. Segregated places for Black people were not as nice as the places for white people.

This holiday celebrates a man named Martin Luther King Jr. He is also known as Dr. King and MLK. Dr. King was a brave leader who worked hard to make the United States a better place.
Dr. King was born in Georgia in 1929. At that time, many places in the United States were segregated.

means that Black people were kept apart from white people. Black people could not go to the same schools, parks, restaurants, or libraries as white people. Segregated places for Black people were not as nice as the places for white people.
Dr. King believed segregation was wrong. He spent his life working to end segregation so Black people would be treated fairly. He became a leader in the civil rights movement. The
was a group of thousands of Black and white people who worked together to end segregation.

is when someone gives up something for others. Many soldiers have died protecting the United States. So, people honor these soldiers on Memorial Day.
means remembering someone and showing them great respect.

is when someone gives up something for others. Many soldiers have died protecting the United States. So, people honor these soldiers on Memorial Day.
means remembering someone and showing them great respect.

paragraphs.text: The United States did not always celebrate Memorial Day. It began after the Civil War, over 150 years ago. During that war, Americans in the North and the South fought against each other. Many soldiers on both sides died.

After the Civil War, families came together one day in May to honor these soldiers. Later, Americans continued celebrating the holiday to honor soldiers who died in other wars. Today, we call this holiday Memorial Day.

pieces.text: Many Jewish people celebrate a holiday called

. Rosh Hashanah is sometimes called the Jewish New Year. It is always celebrated in the fall. But the date changes every year, because it is based on a special calendar that counts days and months differently. In some years, Rosh Hashanah is celebrated in September. In other years, it is celebrated in October.

paragraphs.text: The name "Rosh Hashanah" means "head of the year" in a language called Hebrew. In other words, it is the start of a new year. It is a time to think about the year that just ended. People remember the things they did in the past year. They think about whether those things were good or bad. People ask each other for forgiveness for any mistakes they may have made. They also think about good things to do in the new year.

Far away in England, a group of settlers sailed away on a ship. A

is a person who moves to a new place to start a new community. In 1620, these settlers from England sailed across the ocean and landed close to where the Wampanoag lived. They built a new town there and called it Plymouth. Today, many people call these settlers the Pilgrims.

was already living in North America. The Wampanoag lived on land that is now part of Rhode Island and Massachusetts. They built many towns where hundreds of people lived together. They fed themselves by farming and fishing.
Far away in England, a group of settlers sailed away on a ship. A

is a person who moves to a new place to start a new community. In 1620, these settlers from England sailed across the ocean and landed close to where the Wampanoag lived. They built a new town there and called it Plymouth. Today, many people call these settlers the Pilgrims.
